::: {.lead-note}

I have worked in Indonesian public procurement since 2015, first inside
provincial government as an asset and procurement officer, then as a
commitment-making official and member of the provincial selection working group,
and from 2021 to 2023 as head of the sub-division responsible for procurement
advisory and technical guidance across North Sulawesi. Since 2018 I have also
worked nationally as a certified facilitator, and I now serve as a competency
assessor for the certification body of Indonesia's National Public Procurement
Agency. My work sits at the point where procurement rules meet procurement
practice: how buying decisions are actually planned, how contracts are actually
managed, and how procurement officials actually acquire competence.

:::

::: {.note}

This page describes my professional practice. It is distinct from my
[academic research](../research.qmd), which is in development, urban, and
regional economics. Where the two meet, in empirical work on competition and
efficiency in Indonesian government procurement, the papers appear under
Research. My full government service record, including roles outside
procurement, is on the [Professional](../professional.qmd) page.

:::

## Areas of expertise

:::: {.grid-2}

::: {.area}

### Procurement Planning & Strategy
Translating programme objectives into a procurement approach: packaging, market
approach, contract type, and timing. Most procurement failures are decided
before the tender opens.

:::

::: {.area}

### Specification & Cost Estimation
Specifications that describe a need rather than a product, and cost estimates
that survive scrutiny. These are the two documents that most often determine
whether a competitive process is possible at all.

:::

::: {.area}

### Supplier Selection
Evaluation design, qualification, and the trade-off between price and value.
Selection method is a policy choice, not an administrative formality.

:::

::: {.area}

### Contract Management
Performance monitoring, variation and claim handling, acceptance, and dispute
resolution, including construction and consultancy contracts.

:::

::: {.area}

### Competency Development
Delivery of training across the four competency subjects of Indonesia's public
procurement framework at all four levels, and competency assessment against the
same standards, from procurement officer to senior public procurement
specialist.

:::

::: {.area}

### Procurement Governance & Policy
Institutional procurement guidelines, probity advice, and drafting of
organisational procurement regulations for public bodies.

:::

::::

## Professional roles

::::: {.entry}

::: {.years}

2025–

:::

:::: {.what}

[Competency Assessor, LSP LKPP]{.role}

::: {.org}

Appointed under [Head of LKPP Decree No. 18 of 2025](https://jdih.lkpp.go.id/regulation/keputusan-kepala-lkpp/keputusan-kepala-lkpp-nomor-18-tahun-2025).
Assesses individual
competency against the national procurement job competency standards (SKJ PBJ)
and the Indonesian national work competency standards (SKKNI PBJ), across eight
schemes: commitment-making officer types A, B, and C; special and general
selection working groups; procurement officer; and senior and associate public
procurement specialist.

:::

::::

:::::

::::: {.entry}

::: {.years}

2023–

:::

:::: {.what}

[Internal Procurement Facilitator, Provincial Training Institution (LPPBJ)]{.role}

::: {.org}

Registered with LKPP as an internal facilitator for the North Sulawesi
provincial procurement training institution, delivered through the Regional
Human Resources Development Agency (BPSDMD). Teaches the four competency
subjects, procurement planning, provider selection, contract management, and
self-managed procurement, at every level of the national framework: level 1 for
entrants, level 2 for procurement officers and first-level specialists, level 3
for commitment-making officers of type B, general selection working groups, and
associate specialists, and level 4 for type A officers, special selection
working groups, and senior specialists. Also serves as coach and evaluator.

:::

[Decree No. 1 of 2026](https://jdih.lkpp.go.id/regulation/keputusan-deputi-iv/keputusan-deputi-iv-nomor-1-tahun-2026).
